blurb: iOutdoor Fishing Adventures provides guided fishing charters in various Florida locations including offshore, inshore, and freshwater fishing. They offer corporate fishing trips and multiple day fishing adventures. Captains are USCG licensed and boats meet safety standards.
extraNote: Small deposit of $50 required at time of reservation · Change or cancellation must be done 24 hours prior to departure date · Full refund if iOutdoor cancels or if cancelled due to weather · Generally meet down by the boat ramps unless otherwise told by captain

quotes.author: Tom Seifert
quotes.text: small mouth on Erie Erie Monday, June 7, 2021 ★★★★★ “ Went on all day smallmouth trip with caption Tom Goodrich on 6/6/2021. we caught several smallmouth over 3 pound, 13 to be exact plus perch, rock bass and drum. have to say the best trip i have taken on a charter. there were 3 of us on the boat and it was a well organized boat with top of the line equipment. I have never seen a caption work so hard to make a trip so memorable for the client. When you want to take a bass fishing trip to Erie contact caption Tom Goodrich” - Tom Seifert

quotes.author: Tim L
quotes.text: Family Favorite! Ft Lauderdale Monday, October 18, 2021 ★★★★★ “ Compliments to Capt. Dave Rhoden, so good that we booked him twice. Six months ago we came to Florida for a medical treatment and had a great time with Capt. Dave. Coming out here again, I asked my kids (ages 5 and 6) what they wanted to do, my little son didn't think twice, "Fishing with Capt. Dave!" Sure enough, Capt. Dave got us on even more fish than on our last trip. My kids had a great time! Thank you so much! God bless!” - Tim L

quotes.author: Lu Lu
quotes.text: BASS fishing!! Okeechobee City Thursday, June 24, 2021 ★★★★★ “ Customer service is good. They would contact you and help you with your needs. The process of how they match you with a captain is the best. We booked a six hours BASS fishing trip, during June we understand the bite could be a little slow but it wasn't at all. I'm upset we didn't book a full day!!! I will book thru Bass Online everytime!!!” - Lu Lu

quotes.author: Avery D
quotes.text: Great Fishing/ Great Captain/Great Time Kissimmee Tuesday, November 30, 2021 ★★★★★ “ We had a great time Bass fishing in Orlando on Lake Toho. It was the best day of fishing I’ve had in a long time. Captain Frank was great. We wanted to catch bass and he made sure we did. My wife and I had a great time I Highly recommend captain Frank” - Avery D
